# Tables

Each table of addresses, jumps and words, entry by entry. An RTS table holds each target minus 1; the target column gives the target. Index: [the reference](index.md).

*addresses*

Cold start address: $8009.

<a id="freq_table"></a>
## [`freq_table`](../../src/music/freq_table.asm#L6) `$9D51-$9ED0`

*words*

SID frequencies, 192 words, low byte first. Even entry 2n: the NTSC frequency of semitone n from C0. Odd entries: the mean of the two neighbours. The last entry is $ffff. Valid notes are $00-$5f. The tunes use notes $01-$54. The driver adds the base $9d51 as two immediates at $9828 and $9bb5.

- **Read by:** [`start_note`](modules/music/tick.md#start_note) [`$982F`](../../src/music/tick.asm#L73), [`start_note`](modules/music/tick.md#start_note) [`$9835`](../../src/music/tick.asm#L76), [`effect_pitch_step`](modules/sound/effects.md#effect_pitch_step) [`$9BBF`](../../src/sound/effects.asm#L82), [`effect_pitch_step`](modules/sound/effects.md#effect_pitch_step) [`$9BC5`](../../src/sound/effects.asm#L85)

## [`tempo_latches`](../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L12) `$9EF1-$9F12`

*words*

CIA 1 timer B values for command $f6 (tempo), 17 words: 1000000 / rate, for 16-80 music ticks per second at 1 MHz. The PAL clock makes each rate 1.5% slower. A larger value gives a slower tune. The tunes use only entries 10-16.

## [`tune_ptrs`](../../src/music/tunes.asm#L6) `$A007-$A0EA`

*addresses*

Start of each tune, 114 words (tunes $00-$71). The sound request $80+n in $dc-$de starts tune n. Tunes $58, $59 and $65-$68 hold only the end command $f2. No request, goto or call starts tunes $58, $59, $60, $65-$68 and $6f-$71.
